comments.author: Francine
comments.body: I got Speed up lvl 2, but cant get lvl 3. Is there any trick?

comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body: You need rank 7 in one of the following skills: sail-handling, surveying, navigation, steering, or rowing. Check if you meet this requirement and the university page for more info.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: Thanks, 3 of those ranks actually are rank 6
